annotations.title: Set when the app counts as slow

description: When the main URL counts as slow and alerts (as a warning, for 5 minutes in a row): automatic, 5× its usual speed between 1.5 and 8 s (seconds omitted or null), or a fixed limit of 1, 2, 3, 5 or 8 seconds. get_uptime shows the current setting and the usual speed. Needs write access.

app.description: The app: its slug, name, domain (shop.app), URL or id. list_apps shows them all.

seconds.description: Fixed limit in seconds; null or left out for automatic

name: set_slow_alert
title: Set when the app counts as slow
